about_the_game:
Wishlist BUMBI on Steam!
This is the Demo version of BUMBI.

Let's be real, most games these days are easy. This isn't that.

Welcome to BUMBI: a hardcore precision platformer where you try not to die. The demo contains a total of 6 levels.

Explore Unforgiving Levels 🌋

Each level introduces taxing trials that will leave you wondering if BUMBI's bone is even worth fetching. From spinning sawblades to scorching slopes, make sure to have your swear jar nearby (you might even be able to go on vacation after finishing this game... if you can).

Precision Platforming in Style 💧

There are no rules here, either be a wimp and play it safe or break some bones trying to achieve the best score in the world. Each level challenges you to showcase your platforming geniusness by offering multiple ways to beat them.

Made with Love 🦴

The developer (me) really wanted to make a game that feels ridiculously fun (and enraging) to play. That's why each and every level is carefully handcrafted. BUMBI's animations have been perfected to accentuate its ridiculous personality and its controls have undergone many months of development at the expense of my sanity. And every sound in the game? It's made entirely by mouth! Cause why not.


We accept no responsibility for broken keyboards.

Included in Demo:

  • 3 Levels from World 1

  • 3 Levels from World 2

Full Game:

  • 6 Worlds

  • 10 Levels Per World

short_description: Expect no handholding in this diehard, handcrafted precision platformer. You play as BUMBI, a dog with a crippling addiction to bones. Make daring jumps, escape fast-moving obstacles, and above all- try not to die (a lot).
